verification_caveat: WebFetch was blocked by the sandbox egress proxy for every external domain. Verification is listing-level: real URLs plus address/phone text carried in search-result titles. No business's own page was opened. Anything below 0.85 agent confidence is a listing match only — confirm the business is still open before sending.
churn_warning: At least nine permanently closed Chinese businesses were hit in one afternoon of searching, several of them ID institutions (Harbor City, Shanghai Garden, Mon Hei). Do not assume a 2024 memory of the International District is current.
segment_gap: 私房菜 / WeChat-based meal-prep operators could not be found. Four discovery angles returned essentially nothing — they advertise inside WeChat groups and 小红书, which western web search does not index. This segment needs a different discovery method and is arguably the best-fit buyer of all.
